== Mount Sardlen; Blinder's Peak; Favlend Mountain ==

Based on Mat's perspective, he doesn't think these hills are mountains, especially compared to the Mountains of Mist. He calls these foothills in Chapter 20 of TGS.

Feel free to move them if you disagree.
